input.overview: For {duration}, the slowest shop pages on io-shop became much slower for some shoppers. A new shop feature had been switched on, and it sent shoppers' pages through a calculation of their typical spend. That calculation likely does far more work the more purchases a shopper has made, so pages became very slow for shoppers with long purchase histories. Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings. Responders were not disturbed: no on-call incident was linked to this one, so nobody was paged. Argus ended the problem by switching the new feature back off, and it confirmed that the feature remains off. Argus has also proposed a lasting fix, but it is only an unapproved draft and has not been put into use.
